description: This file defines a Flutter widget called LocationSearchSheet, which provides a UI for searching and selecting a location. It includes a text input field with suggestions and handles user interactions like filtering suggestions and selecting a location.

classes.name: LocationSearchSheet
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides a bottom sheet UI for location search with suggestions.

classes.name: _LocationSearchSheetState
classes.description: State class managing the UI and logic for LocationSearchSheet, including filtering suggestions and handling user input.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the widget state, setting filtered suggestions to the full list.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the TextEditingController when the widget is destroyed.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget UI, including search input and suggestions list.

methods.name: _onSearchChanged
methods.description: Filters suggestions based on the user's input.

methods.name: _onSearchSubmitted
methods.description: Handles the event when the user submits a search query.
